text: Early first quarter, no score. Buffalo's opening drive stalls at midfield.
Cleveland gets to the Buffalo 4, then settles for three.
Third down at the 7. Leonhard intercepts Orton in the end zone.
Browns driving before the half. Searcy picks off Hoyer instead.
One second left in the half. A 53-yard try, blocked.
Third play of the second half: Haden intercepts Orton at the 30.
Fourth and 3, down 3-0: Orton finds Woods deep, to the 3.
Hogan's touchdown gives Buffalo its first lead of the day.
Four seconds of clock later, West fumbles and Hughes scores.
Three straight punts, then a 49-yard field goal. 17-3.
Searcy's second interception sets up another field goal.
Down 20-3, Cleveland goes to Manziel at quarterback.
Manziel scrambles in from 10. Still two scores down.
Buffalo runs eight times in nine plays, then kicks again.
